guide.line1:
Hey! You're a new face.
I'm Mongdol. I've lived on this island for a long time.
guide.line2:
This used to be a lively island with lots of visitors.
But at some point everyone stopped coming, and now it's an island nobody visits anymore.
guide.line3:
With you here, I think we can bring this island back to life.
Want to help me revive it together?
guide.line4:
Great, let's start with the first step to revive the island.
Here, the time you spend focusing becomes the power that grows the island.
You'll quickly get the hang of it once you try it yourself.

tutorial.step5: Tap an empty spot on the ground to choose your seat.
tutorial.step6:
You can't choose the water or a spot where another resident is sitting.
Just tap the spot you like.
tutorial.step7: Write what you want to do, or skip this step.
tutorial.step9:
Focus has started.
Up top, you'll see the to-do you just wrote and your actual focus time.
tutorial.step10:
While you focus, {{name}} will go fishing.
Focusing together with more people raises the chance of catching a rare fish, so keep that in mind.
tutorial.step12:
You caught your first fish!
You can use this fish to help your island grow!
tutorial.step14:
Let's take a quick break this time.
Tap Take a Break below.
tutorial.step15:
If other residents on the same island are on a break, you can see them together here at the campfire.
Once you've rested enough, tap Resume Focus.
tutorial.step16:
You're back at the spot you picked earlier.
Your to-do and focus time picked up right where they left off before your break, didn't they?
tutorial.step17: Now hold the end focus button for 3 seconds.
tutorial.step19:
The time you just focused has been recorded.
Time spent on break isn't included in your focus time.
tutorial.step20: You can also check the fish you caught by focusing here.
tutorial.step21:
Now tap Back to the Island.
When you get back, I'll give you your first quest to help revive the island.

tips: Focus 25 minutes, rest 5, and you can keep going. One step at a time!
Starting is the hardest part. Try just 10 minutes first.
Keep your phone out of reach and focusing gets much easier.
Write down just one task and your mind feels lighter.
Drink a glass of water before you start. Cats like water too.
On breaks, look out the window instead of at a screen.
Start at the same time each day and your body remembers.
One more minute than yesterday is already great.
Do the hard things when you have the most energy.
Focusing with your islanders helps you last longer than alone.
When you finish, write one line about what you did. It adds up.
Sleepy? Stand up and stretch for a moment, like a cat.
A clear desk helps clear your head too.
Didn't make it today? That's okay. Another issue comes tomorrow morning.
